sentences.text: Across the five tabular benchmarks, Fernwood achieved a higher mean test AUROC (81.2) than Quillgate-GBDT (80.3) and Mesh-MLP (78.3).

Fernwood outperformed Quillgate-GBDT on four of the five benchmarks (Alder-Credit, Birchfield-Churn, Cobalt-Insure, and Edgerton-Default), but Quillgate-GBDT achieved a higher AUROC on Dunmore-Fraud (93.5 vs. 91.1).
Fernwood outperformed Mesh-MLP on all five benchmarks.
No significance tests were reported, so these differences in means should not be interpreted as statistically significant.
